name: Compliance — CIS Level 1
summary: A compliance benchmark built from the CIS Level 1 baseline. Starts in monitor mode: it reports, it does not change devices.

settings.title: Mode
settings.description: Monitor reports compliance without changing devices. Enforcement remediates drift on devices — switch only after reviewing monitor results. This choice is permanent for the benchmark; changing it later recreates it.

settings.title: macOS version
settings.description: The macOS major version the benchmark evaluates (e.g. 26 for Tahoe, 15 for Sequoia).

objectsCreated: 1 compliance benchmark (all CIS Level 1 rules, baseline-recommended values)
